title: [cleanup] Add more ruff rules
description:
**IMPORTANT**: PRs without the template will be CLOSED

### Description of your *pull request* and other information

<!--

Explanation of your *pull request* in arbitrary form goes here. Please **make sure the description explains the purpose and effect** of your *pull request* and is worded well enough to be understood. Provide as much **context and examples** as possible

-->

This PR adds more ruff rules, reflecting the current yt-dlp coding convention. For this, a large-scale code clean-up was necessary.
The benefits of adding additional ruff rules are that:
- PR review will be easier as style mistakes will be caught by the user's editor or CI
- Old code from youtube-dl is brought closer in line with the modern coding conventions of yt-dlp
- Going forward, no code violating these rules will be merged

This PR was written in close collaboration with @bashonly and @Grub4K, who provided their opinion on and thoroughly checked all changes.


In minor version updates, ruff may add additional rules to already selected categories, or move existing rules out of the preview state. This won't cause new violations to show up immediately, as ruff is pinned to a fixed minor version. Periodically, there should be ruff version bump commits/PRs, where any additional violations are cleaned up, or unwanted rules added to the ignores.
Additionally, it should be evaluated if any of the added rules not yet selected are applicable for yt-dlp.

- [x] [Searched](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/search?q=is%3Apr&type=Issues) the bugtracker for similar pull requests

### In order to be accepted and merged into yt-dlp each piece of code must be in public domain or released under [Unlicense](http://unlicense.org/). Check all of the following options that apply:
- [x] I am the original author of this code and I am willing to release it under [Unlicense](http://unlicense.org/)

### What is the purpose of your *pull request*?
- [ ] Fix or improvement to an extractor (Make sure to add/update tests)
- [ ] New extractor ([Piracy websites will not be accepted](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy))
- [x] Core bug fix/improvement
- [ ] New feature (It is strongly [recommended to open an issue first](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#adding-new-feature-or-making-overarching-changes))

</details>
